## Parry bug: before and after

Root cause, `app/js/combat.js`: the `meleeDie` scan feeding the summary row (line 3274) and `firstMeleeDie()` feeding the live Defensive Impulse tray (line 3312) both accepted any equipped item with `group === "Simple" || "Martial"` and regex-scraped `\d*d\d+` out of its `damage` string. Knuckles (`damage: "1d4 Bludgeoning"`) and Shock Gloves (`damage: "Unarmed + 1d4 Electric"`) are `group: "Simple"`, so both matched. Their catalog `damage` is what they *contribute* to a punch, not a die you roll instead of one.

Test character: level 6, Reinforced Skeleton (Blackware, 1d8 base) + Street Scrapper + its Level 6 Upgrade. Resolved unarmed strike **1d12**.

| Equipped | Resolved unarmed | Parry BEFORE | Parry AFTER |
|---|---|---|---|
| nothing (bare hands) | 1d12 | `Roll 1d12 (your unarmed strike)` | `Roll 1d12 (your unarmed strike)` |
| Knuckles | 1d12 | **`Roll 1d4 (Knuckles)`** | `Roll 1d12 (your unarmed strike)` |
| Shock Gloves | 1d12 +1d4 Electric | **`Roll 1d4 (Shock Gloves)`** | `Roll 1d12 (your unarmed strike)` |
| Knife (real weapon) | 1d12 | `Roll 1d4 (Knife)` | `Roll 1d4 (Knife)` (unchanged, correct) |
| Knuckles + Knife | 1d12 | `Roll 1d4 (Knife)` | `Roll 1d4 (Knife)` (augment skipped, weapon wins) |

And on a character with no unarmed die at all, Knuckles now correctly *raises* Parry instead of anything else:

| Equipped | Parry AFTER |
|---|---|
| bare, no die | `Roll 1 (your unarmed strike)` (flat 1) |
| Knuckles | `Roll 1d4 (your unarmed strike)` — the increaser's first step |
| Shock Gloves | `Roll 1 (your unarmed strike)` — a rider, never the base die, so not lowered |

Fix (2 files, additive):
- `app/js/engine.js` — new `isUnarmedAugmentName(name)` derived from the existing `GEAR_UNARMED_STEP` / `GEAR_UNARMED_RIDER` tables (single source of truth, no second hardcoded list) and exported.
- `app/js/combat.js` — new `realMeleeWeapon(n)` helper that rejects unarmed augments; both the summary scan and `firstMeleeDie()` now go through it.

I deliberately did **not** apply the exclusion to the other `Simple || Martial` checks (`combat.js:2648,2717`, `inventory.js:693,1332`, `pdfexport.js:351`, `printsheet.js:234`, `engine.js:1015`). Those classify a weapon for the *attack* row and inventory bucketing, where Knuckles and Shock Gloves genuinely are melee weapon entries. `pdfexport.js` and `printsheet.js` emit no Parry die row at all, so the bug had no third site.

Zero em dashes, en dashes, curly apostrophes or curly quotes in any added line. Working tree left dirty, no git state commands run.

An out-of-table category is fully inert: no crash, no TP leak, no orphan.
- `combat.js:2659` calls `GROUP_CAT[it.group]` with no `cat ?` guard (unlike pdfexport/printsheet). Tested: `effectiveGearTier(ch,"weapons",undefined)` returns `"untrained"` and `R.profTiers.untrained.d20` is `0`. Degrades gracefully, no throw.

**FINDING 1 (pre-existing, not a regression, but it is the one genuine orphan in the weapon-proficiency system and it is a Signature Weapon)**

`app/data/class_stitcher_resources.js:61`
```js
weapons: ["Simple Weapons", "Sidearms", "Dart Guns", "Chem Spewers"],
```
`Dart Guns` and `Chem Spewers` are not members of `EN.rules.gear.weapons` (`app/data/rules.js:305`), and `builder.js:702 gearBucketOf()` returns `null` for both.

Failing scenario, run live: a fresh **level 1 Stitcher / The Toxicologist** with a Chem Spewer equipped. `gearFloorTier(ch,"weapons","Heavy Weapons")` is `untrained`, so the rendered attack row reads

> `Chem Spewer SNAG Ranged Weapon · Heavy Weapons ... HIT +2 DMG 2d6 +2`

No proficiency bonus and a Snag, even though the class prints Chem Spewers as a starting proficiency. (`Dart Guns` costs nothing only by luck: the Dart Gun is `group: "Sidearm"` and `Sidearms` is granted separately, so it renders `HIT +4`.)

Why this matters to the lens: the report audited items to categories and concluded "no orphan risk." It did not audit granted-proficiency strings to categories, which is the direction that actually fails. It also undercuts the manuscript's stated rationale for D ("the row had zero referents"): in this app one class does name a Signature Weapon as a proficiency, and it resolves to nothing. Confirmed identical in `HEAD`, so nothing in this change caused it, and I edited nothing.

---

### Part 2: the Parry fix, before and after from the real code

Probe: level 6 Fury/Juggernaut, Reinforced Skeleton at Blackware (base 1d8). "BEFORE" was produced by stubbing `eng.isUnarmedAugmentName` to return `false`, which is the single behavioral difference inside `realMeleeWeapon` (`app/js/combat.js:3280`). Summary strings were scraped from the rendered DEFEND panel (`meleeDie` scan, line 3286); tray strings from a real click on the Parry **ROLL** button, which is the `firstMeleeDie()` path (line 3323).

| Equipped | Resolved unarmed | Parry BEFORE | Parry AFTER |
|---|---|---|---|
| bare hands | 1d8 | Roll 1d8 (your unarmed strike) | Roll 1d8 (your unarmed strike) |
| Knuckles | 1d10 | **Roll 1d4 (Knuckles)** | Roll 1d10 (your unarmed strike) |
| Shock Gloves | 1d8 | **Roll 1d4 (Shock Gloves)** | Roll 1d8 (your unarmed strike) |
| Knife | 1d8 | Roll 1d4 (Knife) | Roll 1d4 (Knife) |
| Knuckles + Knife | 1d10 | Roll 1d4 (Knuckles) | Roll 1d4 (Knife) |
| Knife + Knuckles (order flipped) | 1d10 | Roll 1d4 (Knife) | Roll 1d4 (Knife) |
| Longsword | 1d8 | Roll 1d8 (Longsword) | Roll 1d8 (Longsword) |
| Claws (signature, 1d6 after change B) | 1d8 | Roll 1d6 (Claws) | Roll 1d6 (Claws) |

Dieless character (no replacer, no talent):

| Equipped | Parry BEFORE | Parry AFTER |
|---|---|---|
| bare | subtract 1 (flat) | subtract 1 (flat) |
| Knuckles | Roll 1d4 (Knuckles) | Roll 1d4 (your unarmed strike) |
| Shock Gloves | **Roll 1d4 (Shock Gloves)** | subtract 1 (flat) |

With two Street Scrapper steps (resolved 1d12): bare 1d12, Knuckles 1d12, Shock Gloves 1d12, Knife 1d4 (Knife) in either equip order. The tray text matched the summary in every one of the nine scenarios I clicked through.

All three lens assertions hold: augments never lower Parry, a bare-handed character rolls the resolved unarmed strike, and a real melee weapon still wins. The Shock Gloves dieless case dropping 1d4 to flat 1 is correct, not a regression: gloves are a rider (`GEAR_UNARMED_RIDER`, 1d4 Electric on a hit), never a base die, and equipping them still does not lower anything relative to bare hands.

Supporting checks:
- `isUnarmedAugmentName` is `true` only for Knuckles and Shock Gloves; `false` for Knife, Claws, Hand Razors. Grep over `app/data/gear_*.js` confirms `"Unarmed + ..."` appears exactly once (`gear_melee.js:40`), so no third augment escapes the name gate.
- All eight signature **melee** weapons are `group: "Simple"` or `"Martial"`, so the `Simple || Martial` filter in `realMeleeWeapon` cannot silently drop a Signature Weapon that the Parry requirement (`app/data/combat.js` `activeDefenses[2]`) explicitly permits.
- `grep -n Parry app/js/pdfexport.js app/js/printsheet.js` returns nothing. No third site, as claimed.

**FINDING 2 (same defect family, still present, pre-existing)**

`app/js/combat.js:3354` and `3412-3414` prefer a shield's Block die over the resolved unarmed strike unconditionally.

Failing scenario, run live: the 1d12-unarmed probe equips a **Scrap Shield** (`blockDie: "1d4"`) and nothing else. Parry drops from `Roll 1d12 (your unarmed strike)` to `Roll 1d4 (Scrap Shield)`. A shield takes your fists away no more than Knuckles do, and the rules text the panel implements reads "Roll the equipped weapon's base damage die ..., or your unarmed strike damage if your hands are what you brought." Section F removed the augment case and left the structurally identical shield case. Shield block dice in the catalog run 1d4 to 1d8, so this bites any character whose resolved unarmed die exceeds their shield's die. Not a regression from this change; the fix is simply narrower than the principle it states in its own comment.

Minor, not defects: the summary and tray both take the **first** equipped melee weapon rather than the largest die (Knife + Greatsword shows the Knife), which is defensible since the rules make the player choose; and Quarterstaff `Versatile (1d8)` parries at 1d6, its base die, which matches the rules wording.

---

### Notes on method

No Node is installed (`node` absent in both shells), so every assertion above was executed against the live `window.EN` at `http://localhost:8777`. Other agents were mutating the shared roster and active character concurrently, which silently invalidated my first two attempts, so each scenario set was configured, rendered, and scraped inside a **single** atomic JS execution. Probe characters `LensParryProbe2/3/4`, `LensParryTray`, `LensProfProbe`, `LensAllWeapons`, `LensStitcher`, `LensInv`, `LensParryEdges`, `LensTabSmoke` remain in the roster. No files were edited and no git state commands were run.
